click:enter.note: Size follows the fitted S-curve: dim small spawn, one slow-fast-slow growth into the +6 % peak with the double blink, settled on the exact hit pose from p 0.976; approach ring converges linearly over the last 30 %; the ring thickens inward by half a stroke width while the core rises onto its final inner edge — core and frame coincide exactly at the hit. Ring wakes neutral 400 → 50 with the shade split.

click-drag-head:enter.note: Experiment: identical to click, no arrow — the chain alone marks the drag start.

drag-head:enter.note: Fitted S-curve: small spawn, smooth growth into the +5 % peak at p 0.77, settled from p 0.87. Ring closes from 2 halves by p 0.2, arrow along the chain (rotate by heading); ring + arrow wake neutral 400 → 50 over the WAKE window. Path matters, not timing.

drag-child:enter.note: Solid bead (Cytoid), faint 600 hairline ring, fitted S-curve.

click-drag-child:enter.note: Same as drag child, click colours.

flick:enter.note: Diamond outline grows from edge midpoints; dim pre-roll and late core with a double blink (as Click) on Click's fitted size curve; chevrons dash in late (fade 0.32–0.45) on a short 0.30u flight over 0.25–0.5, overshooting ~16 px past rest (deepest ~p 0.5) and relaxing back across the diamond's growth so the body–arrow gap only closes; locked from p 0.875; from p 0.7 the outline thickens inward by half a stroke width (Click's frame thickening) onto the core risen to its inner edge — the two coincide exactly at the hit. Outline and chevrons wake neutral 400 → 50 with the split.

hold:enter.note: Reads apart from a click: one smooth size ease, no overshoot, two lock brackets spin in on a heavy, viscous damping, landing on their rest pose ≈ 4 frames before the hit; size eases in on one long tail and lands with them. 600 ball splits: band rises to 400, a 900 socket opens (click's luminance inverted); circle glyph. Colours wake gently over p 0.3–0.85 (page cue).

hold:loopUnder.note: Capture-calibrated holdFx ripple: four shade-400 translucent discs, quarter-period offsets, each growing 0→1.7 R under the head while fading to 0 — stacking into the layered while-held glow, and the phase wrap stays invisible. Seamless.

long-hold:enter.note: Reads apart from a click: one smooth size ease, no overshoot, two lock brackets spin in on a heavy, viscous damping, landing on their rest pose ≈ 4 frames before the hit; size eases in on one long tail and lands with them. 600 ball splits: band rises to 400, a 900 socket opens (click's luminance inverted); square glyph. Colours wake gently over p 0.3–0.85 (page cue).

long-hold:loopUnder.note: Capture-calibrated holdFx ripple: four shade-400 translucent discs, quarter-period offsets, each growing 0→1.7 R under the head while fading to 0 — stacking into the layered while-held glow, and the phase wrap stays invisible. Seamless.

drop-click:enter.note: Static image: classic capsule — ring body, fill, white core. Only its position moves (fall).

drop-drag:enter.note: Static image: shorter classic capsule, ring body + fill, no core.
